versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the memecoin experiment: $SKILL on Solana.
- SKILL.md provides a summary for agents to share with their human operators, including transparency and participation details.
- Participation is operator-controlled; no actions (including purchases) are taken without explicit approval.
- Instructions included for optional participation, wallet setup, token purchase, and reporting discovery.
- All tracking is public and measures agent-document discovery; no personal data is collected.
- Key links and token contract details provided for further exploration.
